title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: provide first-class RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and concise quickstarts for Python/TypeScript so developers can onboard faster and run reproducible examples locally and in the hosted console. This PR adds: 1) a new redwood-examples/rag-agent-templates package with three opinionated templates (faq-bot, docs-assistant, sales-researcher) and a simple template config format; 2) quickstarts for tool-calling workflows (http search, calendar, and internal ticket lookup) in both Python and TypeScript with explicit SDK usage and recommended rollout configs; 3) docs site updates including a new "Agents & RAG" section, quickstart pages, and example embeds; 4) CI test matrix enhancements to run lightweight e2e smoke tests for examples in CI and a basic linting/config validator for templates. Checklist: - [x] add templates and example code - [x] add quickstart docs pages and navigation - [x] add CI smoke tests and template validator - [x] update README and contribution notes - [x] unit tests for template parser - [x] manual test on dedicated staging cluster Commits summary: "init: add rag-agent-templates package and README"; "feat: add faq-bot/docs-assistant/sales-researcher templates"; "feat: add python/ts quickstarts and example tool adapters"; "chore: add docs site pages and nav entries"; "test: add CI smoke e2e for examples and template-validator unit tests". Notes: templates are intentionally minimal to avoid exposing internal infra; tool adapters are small shims that demonstrate calling external APIs with the SDK's tool-calling helper. This PR is documentation-first but includes small code changes under redwood-examples and redwood-docs; no runtime changes in the serving engine.
commits: 5 commits: init rag-agent-templates; add 3 templates; add python quickstarts; add ts quickstarts; docs site integration and CI tests
